audience: restaurants that take bookings with GoTable

useCases.title: Find open tables for a party
useCases.text: Check the availability of a date for a party size. List the tables and table combinations to see which seat a larger group.

useCases.title: Prepare the briefing for tomorrow
useCases.text: List the reservations of a day with the guest comments. Open one reservation to read the notes, allergies and diets before service.

useCases.title: Win back regular guests
useCases.text: Search the guests with many visits and an old last visit date. Use the list for a message to guests who stopped coming.

useCases.title: Move a booking and record the reason
useCases.text: Change the time of a reservation, then add an internal note with the reason. Staff see the note on the reservation.

useCases.title: Book a phone or walk-in guest
useCases.text: Check availability, then create the reservation for the guest. Add the guest to the guest book if the person is new.

useCases.title: Read the latest guest reviews
useCases.text: List the reviews of a restaurant with rating and text. Ask the assistant for the main praise and complaints.
